## Included functionality

- Real Kubernetes SparkApplication list, detail, submit, terminate, and terminal-record deletion.
- Prometheus live metrics and selectable historical usage ranges.
- Same-origin live Driver Spark UI proxy and Spark History Server links.
- Loki-backed persisted Executor logs with time range and ordering controls.
- PostgreSQL-backed users, sessions, history, and operation audit.
- Local account authentication or optional OIDC/Keycloak login with administrator group mapping.
- English/Chinese UI, browser or Helm-configured timezone, and responsive desktop layouts.
- Helm deployment with scoped RBAC and configurable Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Loki, OIDC, Ingress, and certificate settings.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.0.1.tar` — frontend image, load with `docker load -i`.
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.0.1.tar` — backend image, load with `docker load -i`.
- `spark-control-center-1.0.1.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for all packaged assets.

The image names inside the tar archives are `spark-control-center:1.0.1` and `spark-control-center-backend:1.0.1`; no private registry prefix is included.
